Let me draft 2–4 core contributions:

1. Residual learning framework: reformulate layers to fit residual function F(x) := H(x) − x, realized via identity shortcut connections; parameter-free, no extra computation [E030, E031, E047, E052, E057]. Author claim (hypothesis that residual mapping easier to optimize) — author_claim.

2. Empirical evidence on ImageNet: 34-layer plain net has higher error than 18-layer plain (degradation), while 34-layer ResNet reverses this; ResNet-34 reduces top-1 error by 3.5% vs plain-34 [E127, E137, E154]. Observed result.

3. Scaling to very deep: 152-layer ResNet single-model top-5 4.49%, ensemble 3.57% top-5 test error, 1st place ILSVRC 2015; lower complexity than VGG [E034, E151, E175, E173]. Observed result / source fact.

4. Generalization to detection/segmentation: replacing VGG-16 with ResNet-101 under Faster R-CNN, 28% relative improvement in COCO mAP@[.5,.95]; wins in ImageNet detection, localization, COCO detection, segmentation [E248, E249, E003, E005]. Observed result.

Also relative to highway networks: identity shortcuts parameter-free vs gated [E040, E042]. Could include as source_fact in first block.

Also 1202-layer net testing on CIFAR-10: training error <0.1%, test error 7.93% worse than 110-layer (overfitting) [E235, E237, E238, E246]. Boundary condition.
